settings.description: Stand out on ACOVON with your official blue verification badge. Get recognized as a verified creator and make your profile easier for fans to identify.

Verified creator recognition across public profiles, home feed, video player, comments, and livestreams
Stronger profile credibility and authenticity for subscribing patrons

Badges remain subject to ACOVON Terms of Service and anti-impersonation policies. Completed refunds or severe policy violations may result in badge suspension or revocation.
